description: Long-poll a Handoff until the human resolves it, it expires, or the bounded timeout elapses. For the onboarding Question returned by activate_agent_inbox, success requires an answered result with activation_completed true; use a bounded local deadline and treat any terminal answer without that stamp as incomplete.

timeout.description: Seconds to hold the request open; use 0 for an immediate state read.
